notes.title: An update on Together, it's future and temporal anti-aliasing distortion
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Together hasn't progressed much since launch, and I apologize for that. This has been due to a combination of personal circumstances, technical complexity, and financial constraints.

I would like to reimagine Together and eventually bring it to mobile, but it needs to be done properly, which will be costly. Unfortunately, I am no longer in a position to self-fund this project.

I recently booted up Together for the first time in ages on a Meta Quest 3 and noticed that the temporal anti-aliasing was causing significant visual distortion in the distance, particularly noticeable on the trees. I believe this is a resolution issue, and it wasn't apparent on devices like the Rift S (which I developed on).

As such, I want to apologize to anyone who has experienced this issue, and I will be removing the price tag from the project for now.
